newsitem.title: UK: Malaysia Equity Fund picks Peregrine.
newsitem.headline: Malaysia Equity Fund picks Peregrine.

text.p: Shareholders of the $210 million Malaysia Equity Fund have voted to turn the closed end fund into an open ended fund by a majority of 95 percent to five prercent.
"In additon 88 percent voted in favour of of removing some of the incumbent board of directors," Peregrine Securities UK Ltd said in a statement.
The bitter battle for control of the fund ended with a victory for Peregrine over Malaysia Equity Fund, which was advised by Baring Securities.

"The new board will now arrange for the Peregrine proposals to be implemented. This will result in the fund repurchasing 6,983,321 of its shares (77.63 percent of the total issue) from shareholders on October 1 and the fund becoming open ended with effect from October 31," Peregrine said.

Peregrine's success in ousting the existing board stands in marked contrast to other fund battles, last week predator Regent Kingpin was forced to wind up its Chile fund after it emerged that one shareholder had ticked the wrong box in a vote to wind up the GT Chile Growth Fund.
Elsewhere, a war of words for control of the Kleinwort European Investment Trust continues with a hostile bid from TR European Growth.
